pretreatment: The as-received DEZn was kept in a stainless steel bubbler with a manual valve. The ALD chamber was evacuated by a rotary pump (50–70 Pa) before the manual valve of the DEZn bubbler was turned on.
evidence: ZnO thin ﬁlms were grown on silicon (100) substrates using the ALD technique. DEZn and water were used as precursors for zinc and oxidant, respectively. Safety precautions have been applied while handling the DEZn as it would spontaneously catch ﬁre if exposed to air or water. In this case, the as-received DEZn was kept in a stainless steel bubbler with a manual valve. The ALD chamber was evacuated by a rotary pump (50–70 Pa) before the manual valve of the DEZn bubbler was turned on.
